palette: Industrial Charcoal, Electric Indigo, and Fog Grey
lighting: Dusk - 'The Gloaming'. Blue hour light fighting against flickering orange streetlamps and the white glow of server rack LEDs.
instagram_prompts: First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture. A wet sidewalk in SoMa, San Francisco at dusk. The ground is dark asphalt reflecting the indigo sky and a flickering orange streetlamp. In the distance, the blurry white and blue glow of a modern startup office windows. Microscale focus on a small puddle reflecting the skyline. No people, no self-render. World feels enormous.

First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture. Detail of an industrial-chic lobby. A giant Plinko board made of reclaimed wood and brushed aluminum pins. One silver ball is caught between two pins. Harsh shadows from an overhead LED. Macro focus on the texture of the wood and the glint of the aluminum. World is impossibly large. No text, no self-render.

First-person perspective (FPP) optic sensor capture. A bundle of glowing fiber-optic cables protruding from a cracked sidewalk junction box. The cables emit a soft electric indigo light, contrasting with the charcoal grey concrete. Small droplets of fog moisture cling to the wires. Low-angle POV, looking up at the towering silhouette of a brick warehouse. No people, no self-render.
